title: Timeline Service State
description:
Time as a value: an object animated through keyframes, and actions fired when
time reaches them. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/timeline)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

keyframes.description: Keyframes per property of the object

actions.description: Data emitted when time reaches at

length.description: Length in the timeline's unit; 0 is unbounded

loopStart.description: Where the loop starts over from

loopEnd.description: Where the loop starts over; 0 is the length

fps.description: Frames a second an own clock emits

speed.description: Playback speed of an own clock

running.description: Whether an own clock is playing; true plays, false pauses

recording.description: Whether what arrives at a playing own clock's input is kept as actions. Stopping or pausing sets it to false.

recordMode.description: Whether a recording keeps the actions it passes over or clears them

placements.description: When each name plays on this timeline

placement.description: The name a driven timeline takes from its driver; "" takes none
